doc_verification.detail: Documentation at https://api.qdrant.tech/api-reference/collections/delete-collection (v1.19.x, major.minor matched) describes DELETE /collections/{collection_name} returning 200 OK on successful deletion. However, documentation does not specify UTF-8/unicode validation requirements for collection_name parameter. The constraint qdrant_behavioral_delete_collection_001 only states 'returns 200 OK on successful deletion' but does not address invalid UTF-8 characters like lone surrogates (0xD800-0xDFFF range). Expected behavior for invalid UTF-8 in collection names is not documented.

http_semantics.note: Target returned HTTP 200 with result:false (business error code indicating collection not found), but did not return HTTP 4xx indicating invalid UTF-8/parameter format. The 200 response with result:false suggests the collection doesn't exist, not that the name format was rejected as invalid UTF-8.

contract_grounding.note: Constraint is partially aligned - API returned 200 OK as expected for existing collections. However, the constraint does not cover UTF-8 validation for collection names, which is the actual issue being tested (invalid UTF-8 lone surrogate accepted without 4xx error). The constraint is too narrow to cover this validation gap.
